captions.detailed: An industrial-style floor air pump with a tall vertical cylinder, a rectangular base guide, and a sliding stabilizer bar across its bottom. At the top, a horizontal T-handle is attached to a vertical piston rod. One side of the T-handle features a cylindrical sleeve grip with an integrated flat folding tab. The stabilizer bar slides prismatically through the base, the piston rod telescopically translates along the vertical cylinder axis, and the top sleeve grip rotates continuously around the handle bar.
captions.instruction: Generate an industrial floor air pump model with a vertical main cylinder and a rectangular base. It should feature a sliding lower stabilizer bar, a vertical piston rod topped with a horizontal T-handle, and a rotating sleeve grip with a folding tab on the handle. Ensure proper prismatic and continuous joints are defined for the telescoping piston, the sliding stabilizer, and the rotating grip.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a vertical Cylinder for the pump housing and a hollow rectangular Box for the base. Create the telescoping piston rod as an inner Cylinder and the top horizontal handle as a perpendicular Cylinder. Model the sliding stabilizer as a long rectangular Box fitting through the base. Create the rotating sleeve grip by combining a hollow Cylinder with a small rectangular Box for the folding tab, and assemble all components with appropriate prismatic and continuous joints.
